business_problem: IJOOZ needed to cut server and machine-maintenance costs, strengthen compliance and data security, and scale the data-analysis backbone behind a global smart-retail and food-robotics business operating across dozens of countries.
solution_summary: IJOOZ adopted a combined compute, storage, database, and analytics stack on Alibaba Cloud to support its rapidly expanding smart-retail business. Elastic Compute Service provides the scalable application runtime that connects the company's vending, robotics, and wallet experiences while preserving availability as demand fluctuates across countries. Object Storage Service holds larger datasets and operational records, and PolarDB supports the company's transactional and application data with a managed relational backbone. DataWorks organizes the analytics workflows IJOOZ uses to study customer behavior and competitive conditions so the business can improve machine placement, service quality, and operational decisions without maintaining its own analytics plumbing. By moving the stack to Alibaba Cloud, IJOOZ gained a more reliable and elastic infrastructure foundation that reduces maintenance overhead, protects data, and supports global expansion for autonomous retail operations.
business_outcome: IJOOZ improved infrastructure reliability and elasticity, reduced operational burden, and gained a stronger analytics foundation for global smart-retail expansion.

solution_components.name: Object Storage Service
solution_components.role: Stores operational datasets and records generated by the global machine network.

solution_components.name: PolarDB
solution_components.role: Provides the managed relational database layer for operational applications and data.

solution_components.name: DataWorks
solution_components.role: Coordinates analytics workflows used to analyze customers, competitors, and operating data.

data_flow: Operational events from smart machines and wallet-connected services are processed on Elastic Compute Service, stored in PolarDB and Object Storage Service, and then organized through DataWorks for analytics on customer behavior and competitive conditions.
